newsitem.title: GERMANY: Deutsche says cuts EPS estimates on Bayer, BASF.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche says cuts EPS estimates on Bayer, BASF.

text.p: Deutsche Morgan Grenfell said on Wednesday it had lowered some earnings estimates for German chemical groups Bayer AG and BASF AG.
DMG, responding to a Reuters query, also said it had reduced its earnings estimates for chemical group Hoechst AG for 1997 but had raised its estimates for Hoechst for 1998 and 1999.
The recommendation on all three of the major German chemical groups remained unchanged at "neutral" but with a higher weighting for Hoechst within the sector, DMG said.

For BASF, the bank said it expected 1998 earnings per share of 4.90 marks compared with the old expectation of 5.20 marks. DMG lowered its 1999 outlook for BASF to 4.60 marks per share from 4.70 marks
For Bayer, the bank said it lowered its 1997 earnings per share estimate to 4.00 marks from 4.10 marks.
The 1997 earnings outlook for Hoechst was lowered to 3.80 marks per share from 3.90 marks.
But DMG raised its 1998 outlook for Hoechst to 4.70 marks from 4.60 marks and the 1999 outlook to 5.10 marks from 4.90 marks.
